title: WMG AQA Essentials — Assessment, Rubrics, MA1 & CA1

questions.q: When are assessments due to be submitted to AQ for the 26/27 assessment approval cycle?
What must assessment rubrics contain to support faster and easier feedback?
answers: A single generic mark band description used across all modules
Marks allocated separately for presentation, spelling, punctuation and grammar
The staff-facing marking guidance copied into each row
Learning outcome-specific wording, adapting the standard wording as appropriate

questions.q: Can an assessment stay the same from one academic year to the next?
answers: No — assessments must be substantially different to last year and changed every academic year
Yes — provided the learning outcomes have not changed
Yes — provided the external examiner approves no change
No — but only the resit assessment needs to change

questions.q: By what date must New Course Approvals or updates to courses (CA1/MA1 paperwork) for 28/29 launch be submitted?
The MA1 updates being submitted in the next academic year are for which launch year?
Where can a moderator get hands-on support if they're unsure how to sample or complete the moderation form?
answers: Moderation drop-in sessions in the IDL
By scaling the cohort's marks to a normal distribution
By emailing the Education Operations team to complete the moderation form for them
By clicking 'Skip moderation and send to admin' to save time

questions.q: Within how many University working days must marks and feedback normally be returned to students?
A mean outside 55–65 (PGT) or an SD below 6 means…
answers: Look harder — it's a prompt for the moderator's judgement, not a verdict

questions.q: You've been invited to a Huddle. This is because…
answers: Your failure rate nudged over 10%, so now everyone gets a meeting
